meta.title: Bilibili watch statistics
meta.description: Pulls Bilibili watch history, computes viewing type and numbers, lets a model write an overview and behaviour hypotheses from the video titles, and can push them by DM or email.

card.empty: Not enough records in this window, or no clear pattern.
card.factsOnly: Numbers only: the model gave no conclusions this time.
card.footer: Numbers come from Bilibili; viewing type and whether you clicked are inference.
